::: {style="width: 80%; margin: 0 auto;"}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof t1_val = Inputs.range([0.1, 4.0], {value: 0.88, step: 0.05, label: "T₁ relaxation time (seconds)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
t1_data = {
  const points = [];
  for (let t = 0; t <= 6; t += 0.02) {
    points.push({
      time: t,
      intensity: 1 - Math.exp(-t / t1_val)
    });
  }
  return points;
}

Plot.plot({
  grid: true,
  width: width,
  height: 400,
  y: {
    domain: [0, 1.1],
    label: "Longitudinal Magnetization (Mz / M0)"
  },
  x: {
    domain: [0, 6],
    label: "Time (seconds)"
  },
  marks: [
    Plot.line(t1_data, {x: "time", y: "intensity", stroke: "#2e7d32", strokeWidth: 3}),
    Plot.ruleX([t1_val], {stroke: "#d32f2f", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
    Plot.ruleY([1 - Math.exp(-1)], {stroke: "#d32f2f", strokeDasharray: "4,4"}),
    Plot.dot([{time: t1_val, intensity: 1 - Math.exp(-1)}], {x: "time", y: "intensity", fill: "#d32f2f", r: 6}),
    Plot.text([{time: t1_val, intensity: 1 - Math.exp(-1)}], {
      x: "time", 
      y: "intensity", 
      text: d => `t = T₁ (${d.time.toFixed(2)}s, ~63.2% recovery)`, 
      dy: -15, 
      dx: 10,
      textAnchor: "start",
      fontSize: 12,
      fill: "#d32f2f"
    })
  ]
})
```
